verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes a REST API reference with per-endpoint pages. The Create Chat Completion page renders a live 'Try it' playground (Mintlify) alongside the request/response schema, so endpoints can be run in-browser. A published OpenAPI 3.1 spec backs the reference; the probe's 404s at standard paths do not contradict the spec listed in llms.txt. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground, explicit evidence that the playground covers all endpoints rather than one example page, documented copyable multi-language code samples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
